primary.purpose: Primary CTAs, active nav item, brand surfaces.

destructive.purpose: Destructive actions, error states, alert banners.

muted.purpose: Muted background for tab strips, hover states, sections.

border.purpose: Default 1px border on inputs, cards, dividers.

ring.purpose: Focus ring color; 1px border + 3px halo at 50% opacity.

label-foreground.purpose: Sub-section labels above grouped fields (text-sub-label utility).

helper-foreground.purpose: Helper text under inputs and unit suffixes inside numeric fields (text-helper, text-unit-suffix utilities).

section-foreground.purpose: Roman-numeral section titles inside forms (text-section-header utility).

warm-cream.purpose: Decorative surface for the login aside and partner-landing hero only. NOT a back-office background.

warm-cream-deep.purpose: Decorative frame for the Board-game.png asset on the login aside.

ink.purpose: Pure ink for the partner-landing marketing surface and the painted-black submit button.

sans.purpose: The only typeface. Body, headings, labels, buttons, navigation. Loaded via next/font/google with the 'vietnamese' and 'latin' subsets; weights 100-900.

mono.purpose: Times, dates, and numeric codes. Used sparingly — only for tabular data and the operational profile's working-hours block.

heading.purpose: Same family as sans; no separate display face. Heading hierarchy is carried by size and weight, not by typeface.

text-sub-label.purpose: Small-caps sub-labels above grouped fields inside forms. Replaces ad-hoc class strings of the form 'text-[11px] font-semibold text-neutral-600 uppercase tracking-wide'.

text-section-header.purpose: Roman-numeral section titles inside forms (I. / II. / III. / IV.). Replaces 'text-xs font-bold text-neutral-800 uppercase tracking-wider'.

text-helper.purpose: Helper text under inputs, inline info notes, AlertDialog descriptions. Replaces 'text-xs text-neutral-500 leading-snug'.

text-unit-suffix.purpose: Right-aligned suffix inside numeric inputs (đ, phút, %). pointer-events: none keeps the suffix from intercepting clicks while the input remains focusable; user-select: none keeps the suffix out of copy-paste.

shadows.name: card-ambient
shadows.purpose: The only shadow on Cards. Near-imperceptible at 1× display; visible when several cards stack.

shadows.name: card-ambient-stacked
shadows.purpose: The more elaborate form ambient used in the partner operational profile and POS feature containers.

shadows.name: modal-lift
shadows.purpose: The AlertDialog and partner-registration image lightbox lift. The only place a real shadow earns its keep.

shadows.name: active-nav-inset
shadows.purpose: The 3px scarlet inset on the left edge of the active sidebar menu item. Depth comes from color, not shadow.

shadows.name: avatar-ring
shadows.purpose: A 2px ring in the page background color, used to separate stacked avatar images in a group.

motion.name: color-box-shadow-transition
motion.purpose: Default transition for inputs and buttons (color + box-shadow). The cheapest state change the system uses.

motion.name: all-transition
motion.purpose: Generic transition for the partner-landing marketing surface (reveal animations, hover states).

motion.name: reveal-ease
motion.purpose: IntersectionObserver-driven reveal animation on the partner landing. opacity 0→1 and translateY(16px)→0 over 500ms with ease.

containerMaxWidth.form-card: max-w-sm to max-w-2xl, depending on the form

narrative.northStar: The Board-Game Café at Office Hours
narrative.overview:
BoardVerse is a back-office for a Vietnamese board-game café during a working shift. The aesthetic is the warmth of a neighborhood parlor — wood, cream paper, a single scarlet accent — translated into a tool that staff and owners can run without ceremony. The product is operational, not aspirational: pages are organized as a ledger, copy is in Vietnamese, and the only design the user feels is that the surface has been considered. The brand lives in a single color (scarlet) and a single typeface (Be Vietnam Pro), not in ornament.

Personality: warm, Vietnamese-first, ledger-like. Dense enough to hold a working session; generous enough to let the user breathe. The interface recedes; the work advances.

Tone of voice: operational clarity. Vietnamese copy throughout the back-office. Marketing-speak and puffery are absent; claims are concrete and verifiable.
keyCharacteristics: One accent color. Scarlet (cinnabar, oklch 0.505 0.213 27.518) is reserved for primary actions and brand surfaces. The neutral palette does the rest of the work.
One typeface. Be Vietnam Pro carries body, headings, and labels. No display face; no system fallback as a default.
Flat with focus. Surfaces are flat at rest. The 1px ring + 3px focus shadow is the only depth signal on most controls. Modals and popovers earn their shadow.
Generous padding. Cards pad at 24–40px. Inputs are 36px tall (touch target 44px). The form breathes.
Vietnamese-first copy. Every label, button, error, and message is in Vietnamese. The English words that appear (POS, checkout, bracket) are terms of art, not style.

rules.name: The Cinnabar Rule
rules.body: Scarlet is for brand and primary CTAs only — never for backgrounds, banners, chart bars, or decorative fills. Its rarity is the point. If more than ~5% of any given screen is scarlet, the design is misusing the accent.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: The system has exactly one accent color: scarlet. The chart blues and the portal-color sidebar gradients are exceptions with their own roles (data viz, role identification) and must not bleed into the back-office UI.

rules.name: The Cream Paper Rule
rules.body: Warm cream (#F4EFE8 / #E8DFCF) is a decorative surface only — never a back-office page background. It belongs on the login aside and the partner landing hero. The back-office stays on white/cool-paper/warm-paper.

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Be Vietnam Pro is the only typeface. No display face, no alternate serifs, no system-font fallback. The visual hierarchy is carried by size, weight, and case — never by switching the family.

rules.name: The Small-Caps for Labels Rule
rules.body: Sub-section labels are always rendered in SUB_LABEL_CLASS (11px, semibold, uppercase, tracking-wide) — a small-caps idiom that reads as a chapter marker, not a heading. The roman-numeral section headers carry the actual hierarchy.

rules.name: The Form-Typography-Utility Rule
rules.body: Inside forms, never use text-neutral-* Tailwind defaults directly. Use the four utility classes (text-sub-label, text-section-header, text-helper, text-unit-suffix) so the gray tonal ramp stays defined by the system tokens (label-foreground, section-foreground, helper-foreground), not by Tailwind's neutral ramp. This keeps the form's gray warmth consistent across the back-office, even if the design system later retunes the dark-mode values.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. Shadows appear only as a response to state (hover, elevation, focus) or to a deliberate modal context. The form does not lift on hover. The card does not lift on hover.

rules.name: The Single-Shadow Rule
rules.body: A surface gets one shadow family — not a 1px drop plus a 24px ambient. When a card needs more lift, the modal vocabulary (8px 24px) is used, not a hybrid.

rules.name: The Conditional Submit Rule
rules.body: A form's primary button never lies. Its label and behavior are driven by server state (operationalStatus, canActivate), not by what's currently in the local form fields. If the cafe is DATA_BLANK, the button is 'Kích hoạt quán' — not 'Lưu'. The submit row is a state-driven affordance, not a free-form 'Save' button.

dos: Use scarlet (oklch 0.505 0.213 27.518) for primary CTAs, the active nav item, and brand surfaces only. Keep the accent below ~5% of any given screen.
Carry hierarchy with size and weight, not typeface switches. Be Vietnam Pro at six sizes, three weights, two cases is the entire type system.
Use the 1px hairline border (oklch 0.93 0.007 106.5) as the default separator. Reach for a heavier line only when the section break needs to read as deliberate.
Use h-11 (44px) for the most important button on any page. Use h-9 (36px) for everything else.
Use rounded-md (8px) for form controls and rounded-xl (14px) for cards. Larger radii are reserved for marketing surfaces.
Keep the form's breathing room generous. p-6 to p-8 on cards, gap-4 to gap-6 between fields, gap-1.5 between label and input.
Use the destructive soft-tint (bg-destructive/10 text-destructive) for destructive buttons. Reserve the full destructive fill for inline banners and alert dialogs.
Write copy in Vietnamese. English is reserved for terms of art (POS, checkout, bracket, settle, signalR).
Keep validation messages near the input, in Vietnamese, naming the field and the constraint.
Treat the focus ring (ring-3 ring-ring/50) as the strongest affordance in the system. Every interactive control gets one.

Drive a form's primary button label from server state, not from the local form fields. A cafe in DATA_BLANK shows 'Kích hoạt quán', not 'Lưu'. Use the State-Conditional Submit Row pattern (flex-col-reverse sm:flex-row sm:justify-between gap-3 + h-11 buttons + optional inline blocker list).

Use the form-typography utility classes (text-sub-label, text-section-header, text-helper, text-unit-suffix) inside forms instead of writing ad-hoc text-neutral-* class strings. The utility classes map to documented color tokens (label-foreground, section-foreground, helper-foreground) and are rethemeable in one place.
donts: Don't use gradient text. Emphasis comes from weight or size, not color.
Don't use glass or blur as a default decoration. The backdrop blur on AlertDialog and on SelectContent is functional (the scrim and the menu), not decorative.
Don't use a border-left or border-right above 1px on cards, list items, or callouts. The 3px scarlet inset on the active nav item is the only exception.
Don't reach for hard-offset box-shadow: 4px 4px 0 neobrutalist shadows. The system is not neobrutalist; one such shadow would look like a costume.
Don't use monospace as a costume for 'technical' rather than for code, data, or measurement (times, prices, codes).
Don't use a system display face (Impact, Arial Black) as the display voice. There is no display voice. Be Vietnam Pro is the only voice.
Don't use a Unicode glyph or emoji as a stand-in for an icon. Icons come from lucide-react or @tabler/icons-react, in a single consistent stroke (1.5 or 1.75).
Don't use the warm cream (#F4EFE8 / #E8DFCF) as a back-office page background. It's a decorative surface for the login aside and the partner landing hero only.
Don't use the portal-color gradients (rose-orange, emerald-teal, violet-indigo) in the back-office UI. They are sidebar logo gradients only.
Don't ship a form that congratulates the user for doing nothing. A successful save is one that changed something.
Don't write a button label that names the channel ('Submit', 'Click here'). Name the action ('Lưu hồ sơ vận hành', 'Mở phiên chơi', 'Bắt đầu ca trực').

Don't show a generic 'Save' button when the next action is really a state transition. A 'Kích hoạt quán' CTA is a different surface treatment from a 'Lưu' — different icon (Sparkles vs. none), different copy, different type (button vs. submit). The State-Conditional Submit Row pattern documents the three branches.

Don't write text-neutral-500 / text-neutral-600 / text-neutral-800 directly inside a form. Reach for text-helper / text-sub-label / text-section-header instead. The Tailwind neutrals are an off-ramp from the design system; inside forms, the gray tonal ramp should always be a named utility class.

driftNotes.observation: src/app/layout.tsx loads three families — Be Vietnam Pro (--font-sans), Geist Sans (--font-geist-sans), and Geist Mono (--font-geist-mono). Only Be Vietnam Pro and Geist Mono are referenced in actual code; Geist Sans is loaded but its CSS variable is never used. The design system does not require Geist Sans.

src/components/layout/app-sidebar.tsx hardcodes three Tailwind named-color gradients per portal role (Admin: rose-500/orange-500/amber-500; Staff: emerald-500/teal-500/cyan-500; Manager: violet-500/indigo-500/blue-500). These bypass the scarlet primary. They are decorative logo gradients and should not bleed into the rest of the UI.

src/features/partner/components/partner-operational-profile-form.tsx ships a feature-level exception — a vertical-gradient black submit button with an inset highlight. This is louder than the shadcn primary default and is the most visually prominent element on that page. Treat as a one-off, not a system pattern.

src/features/partner/components/partner-landing.tsx uses hardcoded hex values for the marketing surface (#f6f5f1 page background, #d1f4d6 / #fef3c7 / #fed7aa / #fbd1d1 mock-data tile colors, #16a34a check icon, #166534 dark-green accent on the dashboard tile, #171717 ink). These are decorative marketing assets and should not propagate to back-office surfaces.
